node.statement: For the decomposition C^(n+1)=C^n direct-sum C, let C_X be the (n+1)-by-(n+1) matrix whose upper-right n-by-1 block is X and whose other blocks are zero, and let R_Y be the matrix whose lower-left 1-by-n block is Y^dagger and whose other blocks are zero. Then C_X lies in S_{I_{n+1} tensor P,I_{n+1} tensor Q}, R_Y lies in S_{I_{n+1} tensor Q,I_{n+1} tensor P}, and ||C_X||=||X||, ||R_Y||=||Y||; hence (R_Y,C_X) is a compatible square amplified rectangular pair.
